build.buildCommand: rm -rf bootstrap/cache && mkdir -p bootstrap/cache && chmod -R 775 bootstrap/cache && npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && npm prune --omit=dev --ignore-scripts && composer install --no-dev --no-scripts --no-interaction --optimize-autoloader && php artisan package:discover

deploy.startCommand: php artisan migrate --force && php artisan config:cache && php artisan route:cache && php artisan view:cache && php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=$PORT
